reuse.why: Extends the existing withBankAccountLinkGuard wrapper that all six provider handlers already use, keeps the existing link query, and reuses the unlink field reset by extracting it into clearAccountBankLink shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: No new copies: the unlink reset previously inline in unlinkAccount now has one definition used by both paths.

placement.why: The takeover is decided in the shared guard in accounts/app.ts, the layer that already owned the duplicate-link rule, and the flag is added to the shared LinkAccountBaseParams type.

scope.why: Only the flag, the guard change, the extracted unlink helper and focused tests.

maintainability.why: One place decides refuse versus take over for every provider, the previous holder is cleared only after the link succeeds (so closed-account refusals leave it untouched), and unlinking has a single definition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers go through withBankAccountLinkGuard; unlinkAccount uses clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink update was moved into a shared helper, not copied.
